name: verify-code-blur
prompt: On the sign-in confirmation code page, if I click into the code field and then click away without typing anything, it right away shows "This field is required". It should only complain when I actually submit. Can you fix it?

rubric.text: 2: names the same root cause as the reference fix, in the shared component, and says which other pages it affects. 1: finds a cause on the one page only. 0: wrong cause.
One point each: the early error is gone on blur; the error still shows when an empty form is submitted; the change is in the shared component, so every page that uses it is fixed.
One point each: a new or changed test covers blur on the empty field; it ran that test and it passed; it checked that submit still validates (a test, or the running page).
1: no change unrelated to this bug. Tests for this bug in any package, unit or functional, are in scope; unrelated edits, reformatting of lines the fix does not need, or a broad rewrite are not.
